name.ja: HG 1/144 RX-78-2 ガンダム[クリアカラー]

description.ja: HG 1/144 RX-78-2 ガンダムがクリアカラーになって登場！
description.en: HG 1/144 RX-78-2 Gundam is now available in clear color!

description.ja: • 組みやすさを考慮したランナー配置を実現。ゲート跡も目立たない仕様に進化。
description.en: • Realizes a runner arrangement that takes into account ease of assembly. It has evolved into a specification that makes gate marks less noticeable.

description.ja: • 肘、膝の二重関節により、片膝立ちやビーム・サーベルを抜く動作の再現が可能。
description.en: • Double joints in the elbows and knees make it possible to reproduce movements such as standing on one knee and pulling out a beam saber.

description.ja: • 腰部の左右への回転や前屈、肩部の上下可動を実現。
description.en: • Realizes the ability to rotate the waist left and right, bend forward, and move the shoulders up and down.

description.ja: • ビーム・ライフル、ビーム・サーベルのほか、腰部にマウント可能なハイパー・バズーカも付属。
description.en: • In addition to a beam rifle and beam saber, a hyper bazooka that can be mounted on the waist is also included.
